source_snapshot.procedure: Graceful shutdown SUT via IPMI command: ipmitool -I lanplus -H <BMC IP> -U <BMC username> -P <BMC password> power soft
source_snapshot.criteria: The SUT gracefully shuts down from power-on state; after shutdown no words can be typed in the SOL terminal.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL issues `chassis power soft` then the broader `chassis status`, exposes the password, assumes cipher 17 and leaves shutdown/SOL interpretation to the operator.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly requires explicit approval, target/workload protection, secret-safe execution, correlated OS/console/power evidence, passive SOL observation and no hard-off fallback.

old_problem: The prior record retained Pending for optional soft-control support, OS graceful criteria, SOL semantics, timeout and recovery. IPMI defines control value 5 as an optional ACPI soft-shutdown request and distinguishes it from emergency Power Down. This resolves command meaning; platform support and the evidence needed to prove an actually clean OS shutdown can be versioned as runtime qualification rather than invented per run.
disposition_reason: Issue exactly one approved standard IPMI Soft Shutdown request only on a qualified BMC/OS pair. A completion response is not proof because the specification permits response before action and the function is optional. PASS therefore requires the OS's normal shutdown sequence and clean-shutdown evidence, canonical chassis Off, and passive SOL closure/inactive-session evidence. Timeout or unsupported response stops without hard-off fallback or retry.
decision_basis: XLSX row 984, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 985 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 985 / variant 6dadbb370df2544e.

IPMI v2.0 Chassis Control value 5 is an optional request to initiate OS soft shutdown through ACPI, distinct from value 0 emergency Power Down. The completion response may precede the actual action, so command success alone cannot pass.

The source's graceful criterion requires OS-level evidence such as the normal shutdown target/event sequence, orderly service/filesystem unmount and absence of an unclean-shutdown indication after the next approved boot; Off state alone does not prove graceful behavior.

The SOL wording is preserved safely as passive proof that the session is closed/inactive or no longer connected to a running host console after shutdown. No keystrokes are injected, and a network/session error cannot substitute for correlated OS and power evidence.

ED-06, ED-15, ED-17, ED-18, ED-19, ED-21 and ED-30 preserve graceful semantics, objective evidence, recovery and independent variant identity; ED-33 through ED-38 allow parameterization with explicit approval and prohibit automatic fallback/retry.

test_case.test_name: Verify one authorized IPMI ACPI soft shutdown with clean OS, Off and passive SOL evidence
test_case.purpose: Verify that the exact qualified BMC/OS pair handles one IPMI Soft Shutdown request as an orderly OS-coordinated shutdown from On to Off, and that the SOL postcondition agrees with shutdown without confusing transport loss with success.
required_package: Immutable SUT/BMC/OS/SOL identity and versioned platform evidence that optional IPMI Chassis Control Soft Shutdown is supported and routed to the intended ACPI/OS handler
Approved protected IPMI path, pinned ipmitool/parser and reviewed Script revision with secret-safe credentials
Maintenance window, drained or explicitly authorized workloads, initial On/OS Ready/SOL baseline and owner-approved final Off state
Version-specific OS clean-shutdown markers, service/filesystem unmount criteria, expected event allowlist, canonical power-state parser and bounded shutdown timeout
Read-only SOL session-state/console observer that distinguishes clean closure/inactive host console from BMC, network or authentication failure
Explicit action approval, OOB recovery access, named operator and incident runbook with no automatic hard-off fallback
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED HYBRID PROCEDURE ONLY; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Bind the exact SUT/BMC/OS/SOL identities, preserve logs, prove initial chassis On, OS Ready and functional SOL, drain workloads, and begin read-only OS/console/power monitoring. After explicit approval, use the protected secret-safe path to issue exactly one canonical `chassis power soft` request. Record completion but continue bounded observation of the normal OS shutdown/service stop/filesystem unmount sequence, canonical `chassis power status` until stable Off, and passive SOL state until the host console is closed/inactive. Do not type into SOL. Correlate timestamps and distinguish any BMC/network/SOL transport fault. Preserve all logs without clearing and leave the SUT Off. On timeout, unsupported completion or ambiguity, stop; do not send hard off, reset, cycle, another soft request or automatic recovery.
test_case.expected_result: The qualified platform accepts the one soft request and completes the approved normal OS shutdown sequence within timeout, with orderly service/filesystem shutdown, canonical stable Off state and passive SOL closure/inactive-host evidence. No transport fault is misclassified, no hard power fallback occurs, expected events are present without unexplained faults, and the host remains in the approved Off state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires prior support qualification, exact target, approval, one soft request, normal OS shutdown evidence, stable canonical Off and passive SOL closure/inactive state with healthy BMC/network correlation. Completion code alone, Off alone, SOL EOF alone, injected keystrokes, DeepSeek's broader `chassis status`, hard Power Down, reset or cycle cannot pass. Unsupported command, wrong target, active unapproved workload, timeout, unclean filesystem/service shutdown, ambiguous power/SOL state, transport failure or unexpected logs is FAIL; absent versioned runtime bindings is NOT READY rather than Engineering Decision Pending.
safety_gate: Require explicit approval immediately before the soft request after rechecking target, On state, workload drain, support qualification and recovery readiness.
Preserve SEL, OS, service, filesystem, console and SOL evidence; do not clear logs or expose credentials.
Permit exactly one allowlisted soft request and read-only polling; deny hard off, on, reset, cycle, policy writes and arbitrary commands.
Observe SOL passively. Do not inject characters merely to prove that input is unavailable, and do not treat session/network/authentication loss as shutdown evidence.
Stop on unsupported response, target mismatch, timeout, abnormal OS shutdown, lost management, ambiguous Off/SOL state or alarm. Never automatically retry or fall back to a hard action.
Any later power-on for clean-shutdown verification or operational recovery is a separately approved action outside this test execution.
expected_evidence: Support matrix and exact SUT/BMC/OS/SOL versions, target binding, approval, workload state and initial On/OS Ready/SOL baseline
Redacted one-time soft-command request/completion, tool/parser/Script versions and correlated timestamps
OS normal shutdown/service stop/filesystem unmount evidence and expected-event comparison
Canonical stable Off evidence plus passive SOL closed/inactive result and proof BMC/network observation remained valid
No-clear/no-hard-fallback/no-retry audit, final Off state and engineer verdict; after a separately approved later boot, clean prior-shutdown confirmation if required by the Project
test_case.recovery: If soft shutdown stalls or evidence becomes ambiguous, stop and preserve the current state and logs; do not hard-off or repeat automatically. The named operator evaluates console, BMC and OS state and obtains separate incident authorization for any recovery action. After recovery, validate filesystem/storage/services and the shutdown history before closing or scheduling a new test.

source_conflict.reason: The Master consistently requires soft/graceful shutdown and a SOL postcondition. Safe passive interpretation clarifies the criterion without replacing it; incomplete DeepSeek guidance is not a source conflict.

blocked.reason: IPMI defines the optional soft-shutdown request. Platform support, OS clean-shutdown markers, SOL observation, timings and recovery are bounded versioned Project prerequisites.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Qualified SUT/BMC/OS soft support; protected access; workload policy; OS clean-shutdown and event criteria; Off/SOL parsers; shutdown timeout; final Off state and no-hard-fallback recovery runbook.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; REVIEW-LAYER HYBRID CASE ONLY; NO IPMI, SOL, POWER, LOG, OS OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1
external_authorities.application: Section 28.3 defines control 5 as optional ACPI soft shutdown, distinguishes it from emergency Power Down, and states that completion may be returned before the action occurs.

external_authorities.title: ipmitool pinned power-control value mapping
external_authorities.application: Shows Soft as a distinct Chassis Control value from Down/Off, Up/On, Cycle and Reset.

external_authorities.title: ipmitool command manual
external_authorities.application: Documents `chassis power soft` as a dedicated power subcommand and supports keeping its command coverage distinct.

project_authority: The Project owner qualifies the optional BMC/OS handler, defines orderly OS/service/filesystem evidence, SOL transport semantics, timeout and recovery, and authorizes the workload outage. These are versioned execution bindings, not unresolved standard-command semantics.
